name: Holland America Line Rewards Visa® Card

localized_names.en: Holland America Line Rewards Visa® Card

apr.notes: Variable APR 18.49%–29.49% for purchases (based on creditworthiness); cash advance APR 29.74%. 0% introductory APR for 15 billing cycles on balance transfers made within 45 days of account opening. Balance transfer fee: 5% (min. $5). Cash advance fee: 5% (min. $10). Minimum monthly interest charge $0.50.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee: 0%. No foreign transaction fees on purchases made while traveling abroad.

base_rate.description: Earn 1 Point per $1 spent on all other purchases.

categories.label: 2x Points on all Holland America Line purchases, including onboard purchases

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem points for onboard credit, statement credits toward Holland America Line purchases, and more. 20,000 bonus points can be redeemed for a $200 onboard credit.

signup_bonus.description: Earn 20,000 Points after spending $1,000 within the first 90 days — enough to redeem for a $200 onboard credit.

benefits.title: Visa Signature Concierge Service
benefits.description: Visa Signature Concierge service is available 24 hours a day and provides personal assistance via telephone, including recommendations and reservations.

benefits.title: No Foreign Transaction Fees
benefits.description: No foreign transaction fees on purchases made while traveling abroad.

benefits.title: $0 Fraud Liability Protection
benefits.description: You're not responsible for unauthorized charges.

benefits.title: Free Online FICO Credit Score Access
benefits.description: Free online access to your FICO Credit Score lets you keep an eye on your credit score and get alerts when we learn that your score has changed.

benefits.title: Travel Coverages
benefits.description: Eligibility for Travel Accident Insurance, Trip Cancellation and Interruption coverage, Baggage Delay Insurance, and Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver.

notes: No annual fee. Visa Signature card (applicants not meeting credit criteria may receive a Platinum card with different benefits). Rewards: 2x on Holland America Line purchases including onboard, 1x elsewhere. All rates/fees/benefits verified from official Holland America Visa product page.
